description_en: Queries the details of a specified security group, including the list of security group rules
description_zh: 本接口主要用于查询一个指定安全组的详细信息，并关联查询安全组规则详细信息列表
kebab_example: aliyun ecs describe-security-group-attribute --security-group-id sg-bp1gxw6bznjjvhu30000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeSecurityGroupAttribute

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the security group. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 安全组所属地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The network type of the security group rule.

For security groups in a VPC, the only valid value is intranet (default), which indicates internal network.
    > If you set this parameter to internet or leave it empty, the value is automatically set to intranet.

Valid values for security groups in the classic network:
    - internet (default): Internet.
    - intranet: internal network.
    > The classic network feature has been offline. For details, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2833134.html
parameters.help_zh:
安全组规则的网卡类型。

专有网络类型安全组的取值只能为：intranet（默认），即内网。
    > 如果传入internet或空值，则会默认转化为intranet。

经典网络类型安全组的取值范围：
    - internet（默认）：公网。
    - intranet：内网。
    > 经典网络功能已下线，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2833134.html
parameters.name: nic_type

parameters.help_en:
The direction of the security group rule. Valid values: 
         
egress: outbound.
ingress: inbound.
all: both inbound and outbound.

Default value: all
parameters.help_zh:
安全组规则授权方向。取值范围： 
         
egress：安全组出方向。
ingress：安全组入方向。
all：不区分方向。

默认值：all
parameters.name: direction

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. Set this parameter to the NextToken value returned in the previous call. You do not need to set this parameter for the first request
parameters.help_zh: 查询凭证（Token）。取值为上一次调用该接口返回的 NextToken 参数值，初次调用接口时无需设置该参数
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries per page for a paged query.

Minimum value: 10.
Maximum value: 1000.

Default value: 500
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时每页的最大条目数。

最小值：10。
最大值：1000。

默认值为 500
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The security group attribute. Valid values:

snapshotPolicyIds: queries the snapshot policies associated with the security group
parameters.help_zh:
安全组属性，取值范围：

snapshotPolicyIds：查询安全组关联的快照策略信息

VpcId.description_en:
The VPC ID. If a VPC ID is returned, the network type of the security group is VPC. Otherwise, the security group belongs to the classic network.

The classic network feature has been offline. For details, see [Retirement announcement]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2833134.html）
